_comment: Local-dev-only defaults. Every value here MUST be overridden via environment variables in staging/production.

ConnectionStrings._comment: MED-18 FIX: No default connection string. Must be set via environment variable ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection or Database:PrimaryConnection. Example: Server=<host>;Port=3306;Database=hrms_db;User ID=hrms;Password=<secret>;SslMode=Required

Database._comment: PrimaryConnection overrides DefaultConnection when set. EnableReadReplica routes ReadReplicaDbContext to ReplicaConnection (requires MySQL Group Replication or async replication at infra level). AutoMigrate=false — always use the dedicated migrate Docker service.

_comment: FIX H-01: RS256 asymmetric signing. PrivateKeyPem is used to sign tokens (server only).
PublicKeyPem is used to verify tokens (can be shared with downstream services).
FIX H-02: ExpiresInMinutes=30 — reduced from prior 8–12 h to limit exposure window.
Generate a key pair: chmod +x scripts/generate-rsa-keys.sh && ./scripts/generate-rsa-keys.sh
Set via env vars: Jwt__PrivateKeyPem and Jwt__PublicKeyPem (multi-line PEM, use \n or Docker secrets).

Security._comment: Base64-encoded 32-byte AES-256 key for PII column encryption. Generate: openssl rand -base64 32
Security._commentPasswordPolicy: Item 8 — server-side password complexity. Bound to PasswordPolicyOptions and validated at startup; MinLength may never be set below 8. Configuration can only make the policy stricter in practice. AdditionalDeniedPasswords is merged with the built-in common-password deny list (case-insensitive).

Swagger._comment: Set Enabled=true only for dev/staging. Set Username+Password to protect the UI.

Cors._comment: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API.

Redis._comment: Optional. When set, rate-limiter counters are shared across all API instances.

Email._comment: SMTP settings for MailKit. When Host is empty, the app logs emails instead of sending. Port 587 + UseSsl=false is the correct STARTTLS configuration (plain TCP upgrades to TLS via EHLO STARTTLS). For implicit TLS use Port=465 and UseSsl=true. Do NOT set UseSsl=true on port 587 — it will handshake-fail.

OpenTelemetry._comment: Metrics are always collected and served on GET /metrics for Prometheus to scrape. Traces are exported over OTLP only when OtlpEndpoint is set (docker-compose points it at the jaeger service). OtlpProtocol: grpc | http/protobuf (inferred from the port when blank). ExportMetricsViaOtlp is opt-in and off by default so Prometheus stays the single metrics pipeline. ZipkinEndpoint was never implemented and has been removed; JaegerEndpoint remains only as a legacy alias for OtlpEndpoint.

Monitoring._comment: Seq structured log server URL. Leave blank to disable.

_commentAllowedHosts: FIX 7: Development default only. In Production this MUST be overridden via the AllowedHosts environment variable (semicolon-separated hostnames). EnvironmentValidator.Validate() will block startup if AllowedHosts remains '*' in a non-Development environment. Example: AllowedHosts=app.yourcompany.com;api.yourcompany.com

Attendance._comment: Number of calendar days in the past that HR/Admin may back-date edit attendance.

Webhook._comment: AllowedDomainSuffixes: when non-empty, only HTTPS URLs whose host ends with one of these suffixes are accepted as webhook targets. Provides an explicit allowlist on top of the private-IP blocklist. Example: ["hooks.slack.com", "yourdomain.com"]. Empty = accept any public HTTPS endpoint (SSRF IP-block still applies).

Compliance._comment: DpoEmail: Data Protection Officer contact address — required for DPDP/GDPR breach notification (within 72 h). ComplianceRegime: active baseline — dpdp (India DPDP Act 2023, default), gdpr (EU GDPR), iso27001, soc2.

_comment: EnableRealtime: Realtime biometric provider feature flag. Default: false (stub mode).
The Realtime SDK/HTTP API integration is not yet implemented. Keep this false until the
integration is complete. When false, /api/biometric/sync and /api/biometric/status/realtime
return HTTP 501 with a clear 'not yet integrated' message.
Required before enabling: Realtime SDK credentials, RealtimeHost, RealtimePort.

RateLimiting._comment: FIX HIGH-6: Configurable rate limiter limits (requests/minute per IP). Adjust per environment.

_comment: UseInMemory: Set true ONLY for Development/CI/tests (no Redis required).
Non-development environments MUST use Redis-backed storage (Hangfire.Redis.StackExchange).
Redis:ConnectionString is the connection string used by Hangfire in production.
EnvironmentValidator blocks startup if UseInMemory=true in non-Development environments.

DemoMode._comment: Production-safe demo mode configuration. Demo Mode disabled by default.
